title: theorycloud_refresh_rotation_recovery.v0.1 conformance fixture
description: Scenario trace asserting conformant or banned behavior under the refresh rotation/recovery contract. Rules are evaluated in order (R1..R8); the first violation is the case's verdict.

case_id.description: Must equal the fixture filename without .json.

expected_violation.description: Required on nonconformant fixtures: the rule the scenario violates. Forbidden on conformant fixtures.

serve_window_seconds.description: W: min(replay retention, refresh concurrency grace); both knobs move together (R3).

refresh_due_fraction.description: Fraction of TTL at which a token is due for refresh; g_min = fraction x TTL.

generation_bound.description: N: walk hop budget and retention cap only, never a revocation predicate (R4).

window_source.description: Provenance marker for the window derivation. steward_sleep is banned (R3); absent means measured_recovery_latency.

generation.description: Token generation presented or consumed, e.g. g5.

successor.description: Generation minted by a rotate/rescue_mint, or chain head reached by an advance.

minted.description: Whether a successor was actually minted. false means fail-closed before minting (R1).

artifact_atomic.description: Whether the consumed->successor replay artifact was written in the same atomic transaction (R1).

wire.description: What the actor observed on the wire. lost = response never arrived.

in_window.description: Whether a presentation falls inside the serve window W.

recovery.description: How a present was recovered; walk_serve = served the current successor via the artifact chain.

reason.description: Revocation trigger. R5 permits only out_of_window_replay, containment, explicit; count_exceeded is R4's banned predicate.

trigger_error.description: Wire error the facade classified before a family_kill (R7: only invalid_grant is contract-terminal).

hops.description: Generation distance covered by an advance event.

receipt_emitted.description: R8: every revocation emits a receipt; no silent revocations.
